newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential boosts Home Depot.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential boosts Home Depot.

text.p: -- Prudential raised its rating on Home Depot Inc to buy from hold, a Prudential source said.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.
-- Prudential analyst Wayne Hood later said he added Home Depot to the firm's "single best idea" list for the retail sector, replacing Dayton Hudson Corp, which remains on the buy list.
-- Hood said Home Depot is on track to meeting management's business goals.
-- Same-store sales for the fourth quarter to date are up about 7 percent, he said.
-- Hood sees Home Depot's stock trading as high as $59 within the next six months, with limited down-side possibilities.
